notes.content:

notes.title: Update 1.1.2
notes.content:
[h1]Bugfix update![/h1]

[h3]Changes in 1.1.2:[/h3]
[list]
[*] The game now remembers one's window position and restores it during the next playing session if played in windowed mode. This also should prevent game window caption from being hidden behind Windows taskbar, if it is placed on the top edge of the screen.
[*] Fixed a minor visual glitch, which probably no one noticed anyway. It was related to brightness of 2x2 gem blocks when they are split back into small ones to give way for Options menu or Match Results popup.
[/list]

[h2]My thanks for reporting issues![/h2]

tags.feature: The game now remembers one's window position and restores it during the next playing session if played in windowed mode.

tags.bug: Fixed a minor visual glitch, which probably no one noticed anyway.

notes.title: Update 1.1.1: Alternative Tileset
notes.content:
[h3]This update adds a slightly different gem presentation mode[/h3]
The mode is activated and deactivated via a button on Esc menu. When it is on, small symbols are drawn on top of free gems, providing additional means of differentiating them.

tags.feature: The mode is activated and deactivated via a button on Esc menu. When it is on, small symbols are drawn on top of free gems, providing additional means of differentiating them.

notes.title: Major Update 1.1.0: Arenas and More

tags.feature: Most notably, of course, [b]25 different arenas[/b] were added to the game.
Hints for starters that will help new players make their first step;
Match starting animation is now skippable! Just click or press any key;
Conquered blocks of gems now fuse together into bigger gems!

tags.bug: Fixed a visual glitch where next move selection animation continued to play while in Esc menu;

tags.feature: A different sound effect when turn results in a large area surrounded and taken over;
Some achievements will now indicate progress toward them;

notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
Following on players' feedback and reviews, the game has been updated.

[h3]Changes in 1.0.1:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added music and SFX volume settings on the Esc menu;
[*] Added Quit button on Victory/Defeat screen;
[*] Added window/taskbar icons (might still be missing with some DPI settings).
[/list]

[h2]Thank you for your feedback and support![/h2]
